spans.s: खट r. 1st cl. (खटति) To desire, to wish, to seek or inquire.

Grass.
 2

. Phlegm, the phlegmatic or watery humor.
 3.
A blind well.
 4. An axe, a hatchet.
 5. A closed or doubled fist, as
for striking.
 6. A plough.
 7. A fragrant kind of grass: see कत्तृण.
E. खट् to seek, to wish, affix अच्.
खट्ट r. 10th cl. (खट्टयति) To cover, to screen.

खट्टा f. (-ट्टा) A kind of grass, (Andropogon serratus.)
 E. खट्ट् to screen,
अङ् and टाप् affs.

खाट mf. (-टः-टा)
 1. A bier, a cot or bedstead on which dead bodies are
conveyed to the pile.
 E. खट् to screen, affix घञ्.

खटक m. (-कः)
 1. A go-between, a man whose business it is to nego-
ciate marriages: see घटक.
 2. The doubled fist of wrestlers or box-
ers.
 E. खट् to seek, to wish, affix वुन्.
खटकामुख m. (-खः) A man in the attitude of shooting.

खटखादक m. (-कः)
 1. An eater.
 2. A glass vessel.
 3. A jackal.
 4. an
animal.
 5. A crow.

खटिक m. (-कः) The fist, the hand closed.
 f. (-का)
 1.

Chalk.
 2

. The
external opening of the ear.
 3. A fragrant grass: (Andropogon
muricatus.)
 E. खट् to seek or wish, वुन् affix, and इट् inserted.

खट्टिक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A hunter, a fowler, one who lives by killing
and selling game.
 f. (-का)
 1. A small bedstead, a cot.
 2. A bier or
bed on which the corpse is carried.
 E. खट्ट् to screen, इकन् aff.
खाटिका f. (-का) A bier: see खाट also खाटी.

खटिनी f. (-नी) Chalk.
 E. खट् to seek, इनि affix, fem. affix ङीष्; also
कठिनी.

खटी f. (-टी) Chalk.
 E. खट् to seek, अच् and ङीष् affs.

खट्टि m. (-ट्टिः) A bier, the bed on which the corpse is carried to the
pile; also खट्टी.
 E. खट्ट् to screen, affix कि.

खाटि f. (-टिः)
 1. Caprice, whim.
 2. A scar.
 3. A bier.
 E. खट् to screen,
&c. इञ् aff.

खट्टन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Dwarfish, short of stature.
 E. खट्ट् to cover or
hide, affix ल्यु.

खट्टाश mf. (-शः-शी) The civet or zebet cat, (Viverra zibetha.)
 E. खट्टा the
grass, and अश who eats; also खट्टास.
खट्टास m. (-सः) The civet: see the preceding.
खट्टेरक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Dwarf, dwarfish.

खट्वा f. (-ट्वा)
 1. A bedstead, a cot, a couch.
 2. A hammock, a swing E.
खट्ट् to hide, Uṇādi affix कन्

खट्वाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A king of the solar line.
 n. (-ङ्गं)
 1. Part of a bed.
 2. A.
club or staff with a skull at the top of it, considered as a weapon
of Siva, and carried by penitents and

Yogis.
 3

. Wood from a fun-
eral pile.
 E. खट्वा a cot, and अङ्ग body or form.

खट्वाङ्गभृत् m. (-भृत्) A name of ŚIVA.
 E. खट्वाङ्ग one of his weapons, भृत्
who maintains.

खट्वाङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) A name of ŚIVA.
 E. खट्वाङ्ग, and इनि aff.

खट्वारूढ mfn. (-ढः-ढा-ढं)
 1. Low, vile, abandoned, iniquitous.
 2. Erring,
going wrong.
 3. Stupid, silly.
 4. Laid or lying on a bed.
 E. खट्वा a
bed, and आरूढ mounted.

खट्विका f. (-का) A small bedstead.
 E. खट्वा a bedstead, and कन् affix. fem.
form.
